bordered.zh-CN: 是否展示边框，仅在非全屏模式下有效。
bordered.en-US: Whether to show a border. Only takes effect in non-full mode.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 替换关闭按钮内的图标；传 null 时不显示关闭按钮。
closeIcon.en-US: Replaces the icon in the close button. Pass null to remove the close button.

fullMode.en-US: Whether the banner is in full mode.

icon.zh-CN: 替换 type 对应的图标；传 null 时不显示图标。
icon.en-US: Replaces the icon of `type`. Pass null to hide the icon.

onClose.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时调用，参数为按钮的原生 click 事件；回调返回后横幅隐藏。
onClose.en-US: Called when the close button is clicked, with its native click event. The banner hides after the callback returns.

type.en-US: Type: info, success, danger or warning.
